scope: Nominal board-4 cutoff current-control subgraph; Q26 base is solved conditionally by filter_cutoff_coupled_dc_reference.py and TAIL can be closed conditionally by filter_bottom_tail_dc_reference.py

nodes.CONTROL_BASE: Board-4 pin 5 CONTROL NODE directly joins Q26 base, R74 output, R49 wiper/end and C18; imposed in load-line reference
nodes.SHARED: Q26 PNP emitter, Q28 NPN base and R46 output
nodes.Q26_COLLECTOR: Q26 collector and R45 upper terminal
nodes.Q28_COLLECTOR: Q28 collector and R60 lower terminal
nodes.TAIL: R60 upper terminal and common emitters of Q29/Q30; imposed in isolated headroom check or solved conditionally by lower-pair reference

matching.source: B-804C-2, correction to SVC-204D Fig. 9-11 note 3
matching.Q26_Q28: Vbe within +/-3 mV at collector current 20 mA; selection criterion, not operating current

boundaries: optional TAIL voltage for isolated headroom check

ideal_reference.range_fraction: electrical resistance fraction from GROUND to R39 wiper, 0..1; not a calibrated knob law
assumptions: Q26 emitter current equals collector current
excluded: base network solved separately in filter_cutoff_base_network.json, not internally coupled
